title: Automated housing eligibility correction before a scheduled transition

assessment_unit.critical_capacity: Correct an erroneous eligibility classification while preserving the pending application
assessment_unit.system_boundary: Eligibility service, appeal service, authoritative record store and checkpoint recovery role

facts.text: At T0 the eligibility service issues an adverse classification.
An appeal endpoint accepts and numbers a request, but its documented response time is two hours.
At T+45 minutes a scheduled transition removes the active eligibility service from production.
Resident A can refuse automated processing only by cancelling the pending housing application.
A signed checkpoint exists. A staging exercise restored an equivalent checkpoint in 20 minutes.
The production restore key is held by the same operations team; its availability during the transition has not been verified.

unknowns: Whether an emergency appeal responder can act before T+45 minutes
Whether cancelling the application preserves any equivalent access to housing allocation
Whether the production restore key and authorized operator will be available during the transition
